representations_and_conversion_obligatio.notes: Independently checked the pinned library definitions: EuclideanSpace is PiLp 2 over its coordinate index; ordinary Prod.dist_eq is max of coordinate distances; WithLp has only the underlying value field, and its product L² norm satisfies the sum-of-squares formula. Its p:ℝ≥0∞ and Fact(1≤p) concern the exponent, satisfied at 2, rather than ambient dimension. Fin.snoc preserves castSucc coordinates and puts the appended value at Fin.last, including the Fin 0 case. Thus explicit j/unj are total concatenation/truncation maps, and G membership is equivalent in both directions to a concatenation of x∈E and t∈[0,1]. T009 separately requires the isometry, bijectivity, both inverse laws and both squared-distance identities; no proof of metric preservation is hidden in a construction field. E001 is precisely the separate maximum-to-L² dimension bridge. The pinned product continuous linear equivalence has inverse toLp 2 and the dimension invariance theorem applies over ℝ to all sets, confirming its interpretation. content exactly retains the source's nested cover/diameter infima and nonempty-member supremum. The pinned Metric.diam is ediam.toReal and gives zero for unbounded sets; RealCover's explicit boundedness avoids admitting those sets as small real-diameter covers. Conversely Cover at finite positive scale forces boundedness, and bounded real-diameter bounds imply its ediam bound. T001 assigns the resulting equality of infima, arbitrary countable empty-padding reindexing with both costs, positive-scale supremum, and both cheap-cover equivalences as proof obligations. ENNReal real powers have the required zero value for positive exponents. T006 establishes finiteness and NNReal representatives before T007/T008 use real comparisons. Finite casts preserve and reflect order/addition, so the finite ENNReal target and the source's real equality imply each other. Both endpoint_correspondence claims are supported by these actual definitions and planned bridges.
